terms.title: Terms of Service
terms.html:
Terms of Service

These terms govern use of the ResolveX technology-enabled business and legal notice facilitation platform. ResolveX is not a law firm and does not promise that a matter will be accepted, that a notice will be issued in the form requested, or that a recipient will respond, comply, pay or settle.

1. Platform scope

ResolveX provides digital account access, structured notice intake, document coordination, payment-stage support, preliminary AI-assisted drafting, advocate workflow coordination where applicable, postal-dispatch support and status tracking. ResolveX may support payment, contract, procurement, HR, operations, property, consumer, data, brand and other documented business notice requirements.

2. AI limitation

AI-assisted output is preliminary, may contain errors and does not independently constitute legal advice or a final legal notice. Users must not rely on AI output without the applicable professional review and factual verification.

3. User responsibilities

You must provide accurate, complete and lawfully obtained information, identify relevant deadlines, possess authority to submit the matter, and avoid uploading forged, misleading, defamatory, unlawful, excessive or unauthorised material. You remain responsible for reviewing factual details and promptly communicating corrections.

4. Advocate independence and matter acceptance

Every legal notice requires the assigned advocate to check client instructions and authority, conflicts, facts, evidence, applicable law and deadlines, and the proper communication route. The advocate must make necessary corrections and updates and approve the exact saved draft before signature or issuance. Administrative checks and AI output do not replace this review. An advocate may request further records, decline the matter or require a separate engagement, and retains independent professional judgment.

5. Standard service and fee

Scope, professional engagement, lawful non-contingent fees, taxes and third-party expenses must be clearly agreed with the client before work proceeds. No outcome-based fee or share of recovery is offered. Existing agreed fees and payment records remain unchanged. Production payment processing requires prior independent review of the actual operator, engagement and remuneration arrangements, including restrictions on sharing professional remuneration with non-advocates.

6. Timelines

Any stated drafting timeline begins only after complete records, successful payment, matter acceptance and required conflict clearance. Complex matters, missing information, revisions, professional availability and third-party services may extend the timeline. Postal delivery time is separate and outside ResolveX's direct control.

7. No guarantee

A notice communicates a formal position, demand or concern. ResolveX and participating advocates do not guarantee payment, recovery, compliance, response, settlement, admission, delivery result or any legal or commercial outcome.

8. Public platform and advocate promotion

ResolveX does not provide public comparative rankings, success-rate claims, guaranteed-result promotions or public advocate profiles designed to solicit legal work. Advocate panelment submissions are subject to verification and do not guarantee panelment, client engagement or matter allocation.

9. Account and document security

You must protect your login credentials and use the platform only for authorised purposes. Reasonable security controls are used, but no internet, email or storage system can be described as completely risk-free.

10. Urgent and specialised matters

Do not use the standard workflow as a substitute for urgent legal advice where limitation periods, criminal exposure, injunctions, regulatory reporting, court deadlines, employment termination risk, data incidents or other high-stakes issues may require immediate specialist action.

privacy.title: Privacy Policy
privacy.html:
Privacy Policy

This policy explains how ResolveX handles information submitted through the website, public enquiry forms and user dashboard.

Information collected

ResolveX may collect names, business and department details, email addresses, phone numbers, login credentials, notice categories, matter facts, recipient details, payment references, uploaded documents, correspondence and technical logs necessary to operate the requested workflow.

How information is used

Information may be used to create accounts, organise business notice records, provide preliminary AI-assisted drafting support, coordinate independent advocate review where applicable, process or verify payment, arrange dispatch, provide support, prevent misuse and maintain operational, accounting or professional records.

AI-assisted processing

Submitted information may be processed through AI-assisted tools for preliminary organisation and drafting. AI output is not independently verified and is subject to human review where legal work is involved. Users should upload only relevant information and avoid unnecessary sensitive personal data.

Limited sharing

Information may be shared on a need-to-know basis with authorised ResolveX personnel, assigned empanelled advocates, payment providers, hosting or technology vendors, and postal or courier providers involved in the requested service. ResolveX does not publish user matter documents.

Retention and deletion

Records may be retained for service delivery, security, dispute, accounting, audit and professional-obligation purposes. For a reasonable access, correction or deletion request, contact support@credend.in. Some records may need to be retained where required by law or legitimate operational obligations.

Security and user precautions

Reasonable security measures are used, but no online system can be described as completely risk-free. Keep credentials private, upload only lawfully obtained and relevant documents, and inform support promptly if you suspect unauthorised access.

refund.title: Refund Policy
refund.html:
Refund Policy

Refund eligibility depends on the stage of work and any third-party cost already incurred.

Eligible situations

A full or partial refund may be considered where payment was duplicated, the matter was declined before substantive work began, or ResolveX cannot provide the agreed standard workflow.

After work begins

Once document review, preliminary drafting, advocate review, redrafting, finalisation or dispatch activity has commenced, the fee is ordinarily non-refundable because professional and operational work has been performed.

Incomplete information

If records are insufficient, the user may be asked for clarification or additional documents. Failure to respond may pause or close the matter and does not automatically create a refund right.

Third-party costs

Postal, courier, payment-gateway and other third-party costs already incurred are non-refundable. Approved refunds are processed to the original payment method, subject to banking and gateway timelines.

Refund requests

Contact support@credend.in with the matter reference, payment reference and reason for the request.

compliance.title: Professional Compliance
compliance.html:
Platform transparency

Technology-enabled workflow with clear professional boundaries.

This page explains the respective roles of ResolveX, AI-assisted tools, business users and independently enrolled advocates.

Platform Disclaimer & Professional Boundaries

1. ResolveX is a technology platform

ResolveX provides account access, structured business notice intake, document coordination, workflow support, preliminary AI-assisted drafting, payment-stage support, advocate coordination where applicable, and dispatch/status tracking. ResolveX is not presented as a law firm.

2. AI-assisted output is preliminary

AI-assisted content is generated from user-supplied information to help organise facts and prepare a preliminary draft. It is not independently verified, may be incomplete or inaccurate, and must not be treated as final legal advice or a final legal notice.

3. Legal work is independently reviewed

Where the matter involves legal drafting, advice or issuance, an enrolled empanelled advocate independently reviews the record, conducts appropriate conflict checks, decides whether the matter can be accepted, determines the legally appropriate framing, requests further information where required, and may revise, decline or recommend an alternative route.

4. No advocate ranking or promotional profile

The public platform does not publish comparative advocate rankings, success rates, guaranteed-result claims, client-acquisition promises or promotional profiles intended to solicit legal work. Panelment applications are for credential verification and potential workflow allocation only.

5. No guarantee of outcome

A notice communicates a formal position, demand or business concern. ResolveX and participating advocates do not guarantee payment, recovery, response, compliance, settlement, admission, delivery result, or any legal or commercial outcome.

6. User responsibility

Users must provide accurate, complete and lawfully obtained information; identify relevant deadlines; avoid abusive, misleading or defamatory content; review factual details when asked; and obtain independent advice for urgent, high-risk, limitation-sensitive, criminal, regulatory, court or tribunal matters.

7. Matter-specific scope

The standard workflow is not suitable for every matter. Multiple recipients, foreign parties, urgent limitation issues, specialised statutory proceedings, criminal-law concerns, court filings, appearances, detailed consultations, translations, notarisation or extensive records may require a separate engagement or may be declined.

For questions about platform scope, contact support@credend.in or call .
